name: before_insert
comment: BEFORE exists on SQLite and PostgreSQL; SQL Server has no BEFORE trigger and refuses with DDL-005. PostgreSQL's function returns the row (new) so the write proceeds.

trigger.name: trg_widgets_before
trigger.sql: insert into widget_log (widget_id) select n.id from {new: id} n;

create:
create trigger trg_widgets_before before insert on widgets for each row
begin
insert into widget_log (widget_id) select n.id from (select new.id as id) n;
end
create trigger "trg_widgets_before" before insert on "widgets" for each row execute function "trg_widgets_before_fn"()
